meaningEn: this or that; a masculine singular demonstrative determiner before a noun
meaningKo: 이, 그, 저; 남성 단수 명사 앞에 쓰는 지시 한정사
reason: Removed Korean-specific affectionate or disparaging nuance; French ce is an ordinary demonstrative determiner.

meaningEn: you; the informal singular subject pronoun
meaningKo: 너; 친한 사이에서 한 사람을 주어로 가리키는 대명사
reason: Removed the Korean particle explanation, which does not define the French pronoun.

meaningEn: they; a subject pronoun for a masculine or mixed-gender plural group
meaningKo: 그들; 남성 또는 남녀가 섞인 복수 집단을 주어로 가리키는 대명사
reason: Replaced a singular-person Korean definition with the plural French pronoun meaning.

meaningEn: no; used to give a negative answer or express disagreement
meaningKo: 아니요, 아니; 부정하거나 동의하지 않을 때 하는 말
reason: French non is not restricted to addressing an elder or superior.

meaningEn: a trifle; something of very little importance or size
meaningKo: 아주 작은 것, 사소한 일
reason: Selected the ordinary countable noun sense of rien rather than a generic absence definition; preserved noun POS and ID.

meaningEn: a minus sign used in a calculation or before a negative number
meaningKo: 계산이나 음수 앞에 쓰는 마이너스 기호
reason: Aligned the noun moins with a sign; the imported definition describes subtraction as an operation.

meaningEn: the tone or manner of someone's voice
meaningKo: 말소리의 어조, 말투
reason: The imported definition describes sound in general; selected the common voice-tone sense of ton.

meaningEn: yes; used to agree, give a positive answer, or respond to being called
meaningKo: 네, 응; 동의하거나 긍정적으로 답하거나 부름에 대답하는 말
reason: French oui is not inherently honorific or restricted to answering an elder's call.

meaningEn: what is true; truth as opposed to falsehood
meaningKo: 참된 것, 진실
reason: Clarified the nominal sense of vrai rather than the source definition's generic true logic.

meaningEn: ah; an exclamation expressing discovery, understanding, surprise, or relief
meaningKo: 아; 발견, 이해, 놀람, 안도 등을 나타내는 감탄사
reason: Replaced an exertion-only sense imported from a different Korean interjection.

meaningEn: art; creative expression through painting, sculpture, music, and similar activities
meaningKo: 예술; 미술, 음악 등으로 생각과 감정을 창의적으로 표현하는 활동
reason: Replaced the misleading arts-and-sciences definition with the ordinary French art sense.

meaningEn: awkward or clumsy in movement or behaviour
meaningKo: 동작이나 행동이 어색한, 서투른
reason: The imported definition focuses on embarrassment; French gauche describes awkwardness or clumsiness.

meaningEn: singles; a game played with one player on each side, especially in tennis
meaningKo: 단식; 특히 테니스 등에서 양쪽 한 명씩 겨루는 경기
reason: Selected an ordinary masculine noun sense; the imported generic one-item definition does not identify a usable French noun sense.

meaningEn: almost; nearly, without quite reaching a state or completing an action
meaningKo: 거의; 어떤 상태나 행동에 완전히 이르기 직전까지
reason: Replaced a Korean counterfactual fragment with the French adverb meaning.

meaningEn: yeah; an informal way to say yes
meaningKo: 응, 그래; 일상적인 말투로 하는 긍정의 대답
reason: The imported definition describes surprise or pleasure, while ouais is an informal affirmative.

meaningEn: age; the length of time a person or living thing has lived
meaningKo: 나이; 사람이나 생물이 살아온 시간
reason: Removed honorific marking from the Korean source; French âge is neutral.

meaningEn: a class; a group of pupils or students taught together
meaningKo: 학급, 반; 함께 수업을 받는 학생들의 집단
reason: Narrowed a generic organised-group definition to the relevant French school-class sense.

meaningEn: formation; the arrangement of a group of people, vehicles, or aircraft
meaningKo: 대형; 사람이나 차량, 항공기 등이 배치된 모양
reason: The source restricts the arrangement to a long single line, which is too narrow for formation.

meaningEn: attention; the act of focusing one's mind or senses on something
meaningKo: 주의, 주의 집중; 어떤 것에 정신이나 감각을 모으는 일
reason: Replaced attraction or positive feelings with the French attention sense.

meaningEn: a court; a judicial body that hears cases and delivers decisions
meaningKo: 법원, 재판부; 사건을 심리하고 판결하는 사법 기관
reason: The imported meaning describes the room, whereas cour in this sense denotes the judicial institution or judges.

meaningEn: what is owed to someone; money or something that a person is entitled to receive
meaningKo: 받아야 할 몫이나 돈
reason: Clarified the amount owed; removed the imported abstract state of not collecting it.

meaningEn: a republic; a state whose head is not a hereditary monarch
meaningKo: 공화국; 세습 군주가 국가 원수가 아닌 국가
reason: Replaced a definition of democracy; a republic and equal democratic participation are not equivalent concepts.

meaningEn: an average; a value calculated by adding quantities and dividing by their number
meaningKo: 평균; 여러 수치를 더한 뒤 그 수로 나눈 값
reason: Clarified arithmetic average rather than a vague middle value that could imply the median.

meaningEn: a commission; a fee paid to an intermediary for a sale or service
meaningKo: 수수료; 매매나 서비스를 중개한 대가로 지급하는 돈
reason: Removed the restriction to government or public-body fees, which does not fit the ordinary French commission sense.

meaningEn: one; the number or figure 1, including a result of one in a game
meaningKo: 일; 수나 숫자 1 또는 놀이에서 나온 1
reason: The source consensus definition is not the selected noun sense. The Académie française confirms masculine noun un and no article elision: https://www.dictionnaire-academie.fr/article/A9U0056 .

meaningEn: quickly; at a fast speed or without delay
meaningKo: 빠르게, 신속하게
reason: Removed the restriction to an expression used to hurry someone; rapidement is an ordinary adverb.

meaningEn: a version; a particular form or release of a program, document, or other work
meaningKo: 버전; 프로그램이나 문서 등의 특정 형태나 판
reason: A version is not itself the number used to identify it.

meaningEn: a current; a flow of water in a particular direction
meaningKo: 물살, 물의 흐름
reason: Replaced a mixed definition about sunlight, fire and water with the selected water-current sense.

meaningEn: porter; a style of beer, typically dark
meaningKo: 포터; 보통 색이 짙은 맥주의 한 종류
reason: Narrowed generic beer to the French borrowed noun porter, confirmed in the Académie: https://www.dictionnaire-academie.fr/article/A7P2046 .

meaningEn: style; a characteristic way of doing, creating, or expressing something
meaningKo: 양식, 문체, 스타일; 표현하거나 행동하는 특징적인 방식
reason: The source describes an established custom; selected the ordinary characteristic-manner sense of style.

meaningEn: to obtain, get, or secure something
meaningKo: 얻다, 획득하다
reason: Removed the inaccurate restriction to obtaining something without effort or payment.

meaningEn: light; illumination or a device that provides it
meaningKo: 빛, 조명; 어둠을 밝히는 빛이나 장치
reason: The imported definition restricts lumière to a physical luminous object, while the example uses ordinary household lighting.

meaningEn: a judge; a person whose role is to decide cases in a court
meaningKo: 판사; 법원에서 사건을 심리하고 판결하는 사람
reason: Removed a Korean institutional restriction excluding a supreme court; it is not part of the French noun meaning.

meaningEn: listening; paying attention to what someone says or to sounds
meaningKo: 듣기, 경청; 말이나 소리에 주의를 기울이는 일
reason: Aligned écoute with the act or quality of listening rather than a language-comprehension ability alone.

meaningEn: firm; solid or resistant to pressure
meaningKo: 단단한, 탄탄한; 눌러도 쉽게 변형되지 않는
reason: The imported full-and-useful definition does not match the French adjective; selected the physical firmness sense.

meaningEn: an operation; a task or procedure carried out to achieve a result
meaningKo: 작업, 조작; 어떤 결과를 얻기 위해 수행하는 절차
reason: Replaced machinery merely running with an operation performed as a procedure.

meaningEn: a league; a group of sports teams organised to compete against one another
meaningKo: 리그; 서로 경기를 치르도록 조직된 스포츠 팀들의 집단
reason: The imported definition describes each individual team rather than the league.

meaningEn: evolution; changes in living populations over successive generations
meaningKo: 진화; 여러 세대를 거쳐 생물 집단이 변하는 현상
reason: Clarified biological evolution rather than an individual's development after birth.

meaningEn: a key; a button on a keyboard that is pressed to enter a character or command
meaningKo: 키; 글자나 명령을 입력하기 위해 누르는 키보드의 버튼
reason: Corrected keyboard-versus-key granularity: touche is one key, not the whole keyboard.

meaningEn: to put, place, or set something down
meaningKo: 놓다, 내려놓다
reason: Removed the incorrect restriction to inserting into a space; poser commonly places something on a surface.

meaningEn: literature and the humanities, especially as a field of study
meaningKo: 문학과 인문학, 특히 학문 분야로서의 문학
reason: Retained the plural headword lettres and corrected its article to les; this entry requires grammar.number plural.

meaningEn: a surprise; something unexpected, including an event or gift planned secretly
meaningKo: 놀라운 일, 깜짝 선물이나 행사; 예상하지 못한 것
reason: Replaced a sudden-action definition with the ordinary French unexpected-event sense.

meaningEn: heat or warmth, considered as a temperature condition
meaningKo: 더위, 따뜻함; 온도가 높은 상태
reason: Removed the summer-only restriction for the nominal chaud, often contrasted with froid.

meaningEn: an animal's mouth; also a coarse word for a person's mouth or face
meaningKo: 동물의 입; 사람의 입이나 얼굴을 거칠게 이르는 말이기도 함
reason: Added the ordinary animal sense and the register distinction absent from the generic source definition.

meaningEn: an approach; a method or way of dealing with a subject or problem
meaningKo: 접근법; 주제나 문제를 다루는 방식
reason: The imported close-relationship definition does not fit this French noun; selected the ordinary method sense.

meaningEn: to present, show, or explain something to someone
meaningKo: 제시하다, 보여 주다, 설명하다
reason: Replaced a vague causative-observation definition with ordinary presentation to an audience.

meaningEn: a lycée; a school providing upper secondary education
meaningKo: 리세, 고등학교; 중등 교육의 후반 과정을 제공하는 학교
reason: The imported definition covers any educational institution; lycée denotes upper secondary schooling.

meaningEn: a character in a story, play, film, or similar work
meaningKo: 등장인물; 이야기나 연극, 영화 등에 나오는 인물
reason: Selected the ordinary fictional-character sense rather than the generic person-playing-a-role definition.

meaningEn: an agency or local office representing a business, including a sales agency
meaningKo: 대리점, 영업소; 업체를 대신해 판매나 업무를 맡는 곳
reason: Clarified commercial representation rather than a generic shop.

meaningEn: certainly; undoubtedly or with confidence
meaningKo: 확실히, 틀림없이
reason: Replaced emphasis on factual truth alone with the French certainty adverb sense.

meaningEn: unfortunately; used to introduce an unfavourable fact or outcome
meaningKo: 안타깝게도, 불행히도
reason: Clarified discourse use for an unfortunate outcome rather than simply lacking happiness.

meaningEn: a member of a religious order, especially a monk
meaningKo: 수도자, 특히 수도사; 수도회에 속한 사람
reason: Narrowed the noun to membership of a religious order rather than any person with a religious occupation.

meaningEn: a section; a distinct part or stretch of something
meaningKo: 구간, 부분; 전체에서 구별되는 한 부분
reason: A section denotes a segment rather than the measured distance between two points.

meaningEn: a gift or donation; something given freely to a person or cause
meaningKo: 선물, 기부; 대가 없이 주는 물건이나 돈
reason: Removed the restriction to thanks or celebration; don includes charitable donations.

meaningEn: a treaty; a formal agreement between states or other authorities
meaningKo: 조약; 국가 등 권한 있는 주체 사이의 공식적인 합의
reason: The imported definition describes deciding through discussion; traité is the resulting formal agreement.

meaningEn: to join a person or group; to go to where they are or become part of the group
meaningKo: 합류하다, 가입하다; 사람이나 집단이 있는 곳에 가거나 그 일원이 되다
reason: Replaced a mutual many-groups-gathering definition with the transitive French verb sense.

meaningEn: to defend or protect someone or something against attack or danger
meaningKo: 방어하다, 지키다; 공격이나 위험으로부터 보호하다
reason: Clarified active defence, not merely watching over a place.

meaningEn: a collège; in France, a school between primary school and lycée
meaningKo: 콜레주, 중학교; 프랑스에서 초등학교와 리세 사이의 학교
reason: The imported definition covers any educational institution; collège is a specific school stage in the selected French sense.

meaningEn: justly or fairly; in a way that gives proper consideration to each person
meaningKo: 공정하게, 정당하게
reason: Removed sharpness as a necessary part of the fairness sense.

meaningEn: the fourth person or thing in a sequence or ranking
meaningKo: 네 번째 사람이나 것, 4위
reason: Corrected the ordinal noun sense; the source definition incorrectly gives a total of four.

meaningEn: a smile; a facial expression showing pleasure, friendliness, or amusement
meaningKo: 미소; 기쁨이나 친근함 등을 나타내는 얼굴 표정
reason: Removed laughter and laughing sounds, which do not define sourire.

meaningEn: to smile; to form a facial expression of pleasure, friendliness, or amusement
meaningKo: 미소 짓다
reason: Removed the claim that smiling makes a laughing sound; that belongs to rire.

meaningEn: a trade, profession, or occupation
meaningKo: 직업, 생업
reason: Removed disparaging register imported from a Korean equivalent; métier is neutral.

meaningEn: an event; something that happens, especially an organised occasion
meaningKo: 사건, 행사; 일어나는 일이나 조직된 모임
reason: Replaced the act of carrying out a procedure with an event or organised occasion.

meaningEn: a welcome; the way someone is received or greeted
meaningKo: 맞이, 환영; 사람을 맞아들이는 방식
reason: Replaced general respectful treatment with the specific receiving-and-welcoming sense.

meaningEn: excellent; of very high quality or ability
meaningKo: 아주 훌륭한, 뛰어난
reason: Removed the unnecessary moral-character restriction; excellent can describe quality or skill.

meaningEn: a boy; a male child or young person
meaningKo: 소년, 남자아이
reason: Narrowed the generic male-person definition to the ordinary boy sense.

meaningEn: words; things someone says
meaningKo: 말; 누군가가 하는 이야기
reason: Removed Korean honorific marking and corrected the plural headword's article and grammatical number.

meaningEn: to support; to hold something up or bear its weight
meaningKo: 받치다, 지탱하다
reason: The imported definition describes placement underneath, while soutenir denotes supporting weight.

meaningEn: a digit; one written symbol used to represent a number
meaningKo: 숫자; 수를 적는 데 쓰는 한 기호
reason: Clarified digit rather than a word denoting a number.

meaningEn: a count; a nobleman holding the title of count
meaningKo: 백작; 백작 작위를 가진 귀족
reason: Defined the holder rather than a universal numerical rank in a five-rank system.

meaningEn: childhood; the period of life before adolescence
meaningKo: 어린 시절, 유년기; 청소년기 이전의 시기
reason: Removed the imported restriction to nursery and early primary school years.

meaningEn: behaviour; the way a person or animal acts
meaningKo: 행동, 행실; 사람이나 동물이 행동하는 방식
reason: Behaviour does not necessarily mean doing what one morally should do.

meaningEn: a flat; a self-contained set of rooms within a building used as a home
meaningKo: 아파트 한 세대, 공동주택의 한 주거 공간
reason: Corrected individual dwelling versus the entire residential building.

meaningEn: hunger; the need or desire to eat
meaningKo: 배고픔, 허기
reason: The noun does not require starvation or lack of available food.

meaningEn: climate; the usual weather conditions of a region over a long period
meaningKo: 기후; 오랜 기간에 걸친 지역의 일반적인 날씨 특성
reason: Distinguished climate from short-term weather conditions.

meaningEn: the essential part; what is most important or necessary
meaningKo: 핵심, 꼭 필요한 것
reason: Replaced best-quality part with essential or necessary content.

meaningEn: euro; the currency used in the euro area
meaningKo: 유로; 유로 지역에서 사용하는 통화
reason: Removed the implication that every EU country uses the euro.

meaningEn: Islam; a monotheistic religion whose followers are Muslims
meaningKo: 이슬람교; 무슬림들이 믿는 일신교
reason: Islam names the religion, not an individual Muslim.

meaningEn: race; a socially defined category of people associated with perceived ancestry or physical traits
meaningKo: 인종; 혈통이나 신체적 특징에 대한 인식을 바탕으로 사회적으로 구분하는 범주
reason: Removed obsolete racial typology and biological-essentialist wording from the imported definition.

meaningEn: a duke; a nobleman holding a high hereditary title
meaningKo: 공작; 높은 세습 작위를 가진 귀족
reason: Defined the title holder without claiming a universal five-rank classification.

meaningEn: a river; a natural flowing body of water
meaningKo: 강, 하천; 자연적으로 흐르는 물줄기
reason: Removed lakes and seas, which are not meanings of rivière.

meaningEn: to discuss; to exchange ideas or consider a matter in conversation
meaningKo: 의논하다, 토론하다
reason: Removed the requirement of an argument between opposing sides.

meaningEn: a chemical element; a substance characterised by atoms with the same number of protons
meaningKo: 화학 원소; 양성자 수가 같은 원자로 이루어진 물질
reason: Replaced an inaccurate indivisible-smallest-unit definition with the chemical-element sense used by the example.

meaningEn: conversation; an exchange of spoken words between people
meaningKo: 대화; 사람들이 말을 주고받는 일
reason: Conversation is not restricted to speaking a foreign language.

meaningEn: kind or nice; considerate and pleasant towards others
meaningKo: 친절한, 다정한
reason: Replaced an appearance-only definition with the ordinary interpersonal sense of gentil.

meaningEn: an original; the source document or work from which copies are made
meaningKo: 원본, 원작; 복사본의 바탕이 되는 문서나 작품
reason: The imported first-edition definition does not fit the general original-versus-copy noun sense.

meaningEn: talent; a natural or developed ability to do something well
meaningKo: 재능, 소질
reason: Removed slang marking and the restriction to performing for an audience.

meaningEn: archives; records preserved as evidence or for historical reference
meaningKo: 기록 보관 자료; 증거나 역사적 참고를 위해 보존한 기록
reason: Narrowed generic research material to preserved records.

meaningEn: a major; a military officer rank above captain and below lieutenant colonel in the French army
meaningKo: 소령; 프랑스 육군에서 대위 위, 중령 아래의 장교 계급
reason: Corrected the English rank name lieutenant major to lieutenant colonel and bounded the hierarchy to the French army.

meaningEn: a student, especially a person in higher education
meaningKo: 대학생, 고등 교육 과정의 학생
reason: Narrowed the ordinary French usage from any school pupil to a higher-education student.

meaningEn: an organism; an individual living thing
meaningKo: 생물체; 하나의 생명을 가진 개체
reason: Removed the restriction to animals and plants, which excludes other organisms.

meaningEn: to prove; to demonstrate that something is true using evidence
meaningKo: 입증하다, 증명하다
reason: Corrected the transitive meaning from using something as proof to demonstrating truth with evidence.

meaningEn: current events or news; matters of present interest
meaningKo: 시사, 현재의 소식이나 관심사
reason: The imported generic story-material definition does not capture actualité.

meaningEn: a lieutenant; a junior military officer rank
meaningKo: 중위; 하급 장교 계급
reason: A rank is not identical to the role of platoon commander, even when the two coincide.

meaningEn: a virgin; in this feminine noun use, a woman who has not had sexual intercourse
meaningKo: 처녀; 이 여성 명사 용법에서는 성관계 경험이 없는 여성
reason: Removed the restriction to intercourse with a man while retaining the feminine noun sense.

meaningEn: an extract; a concentrated substance obtained from a plant or other material
meaningKo: 추출물; 식물 등의 원료에서 얻은 농축 성분
reason: An extract need not be pure sap or animal fluid; the source definition is too narrow and inaccurate.

meaningEn: a gay man; a man who is romantically or sexually attracted to men
meaningKo: 게이 남성; 남성에게 연애적 또는 성적 끌림을 느끼는 남성
reason: Aligned the masculine French noun with the male sense rather than a generic person of either sex.

meaningEn: a return or resumption, especially the start of school or work after a break
meaningKo: 복귀, 재개; 특히 방학이나 휴가 뒤의 개학이나 업무 복귀
reason: Clarified the ordinary rentrée sense of returning to an activity rather than only returning to a physical place.

meaningEn: a civilian; someone who is not a member of the armed forces
meaningKo: 민간인; 군인이 아닌 사람
reason: Removed the exclusion of all government officials, who can be civilians.

meaningEn: a disc or record used to store and play recorded sound
meaningKo: 음반, 디스크; 녹음된 소리를 저장하고 재생하는 판
reason: Removed cassette tape, which is not a disque.

meaningEn: solid or sturdy; strong enough to resist pressure or damage
meaningKo: 튼튼한, 견고한; 힘이나 손상을 잘 견디는
reason: Removed rough texture as a requirement; selected structural sturdiness.

meaningEn: effectiveness; the ability to achieve the intended result
meaningKo: 효과, 효과성; 의도한 결과를 이루는 능력
reason: The imported work-per-unit-time definition describes productivity rather than effectiveness.

meaningEn: reputation; the opinion that people generally have of someone or something
meaningKo: 평판; 사람이나 사물에 대해 널리 형성된 평가
reason: Distinguished reputation from merely how widely a name is known.

meaningEn: an adult; a person who has reached the age of legal majority
meaningKo: 성인; 법적으로 성년 연령에 도달한 사람
reason: The noun majeur denotes a person, not the age of majority itself.

meaningEn: a shoot; new plant growth emerging from a stem, root, or seed
meaningKo: 새싹, 새순; 줄기나 뿌리, 씨앗에서 새로 자라는 부분
reason: A shoot is new growth, not necessarily a single leaf.

meaningEn: the fifth person or thing in a sequence or ranking
meaningKo: 다섯 번째 사람이나 것, 5위
reason: Corrected the ordinal noun sense; the imported definition gives a cardinal total of five.

meaningEn: an event; an organised public gathering or activity
meaningKo: 행사; 조직된 공개 모임이나 활동
reason: Selected the cultural-event sense rather than a generic act of implementing a procedure.

meaningEn: dry; lacking moisture
meaningKo: 마른, 건조한; 수분이 부족한
reason: Removed lack of nutrients or soil fertility as a requirement of sec.

meaningEn: to escape or get away from someone or something, usually with à
meaningKo: 벗어나다, 달아나다; 보통 전치사 à와 함께 씀
reason: The imported definition describes dispelling thoughts or drowsiness, which is not the selected French verb meaning.

meaningEn: supply; the provision of power, fuel, food, or other necessary input
meaningKo: 공급; 전력, 연료, 음식 등 필요한 것을 제공하는 일
reason: Replaced generic provision of money or goods with the input-supply sense used in alimentation électrique.

meaningEn: a branch; a woody offshoot growing from a tree's trunk or larger branch
meaningKo: 나뭇가지; 줄기나 더 큰 가지에서 갈라져 자라는 부분
reason: Removed the claim that the branch is already broken off.

meaningEn: an engineer; a professional who designs, develops, or maintains technical systems
meaningKo: 엔지니어, 기술자; 기술 시스템을 설계하거나 개발하고 관리하는 전문가
reason: Narrowed the generic technically skilled person definition to the engineering profession.

meaningEn: a launch; the introduction or start of a product, project, or activity
meaningKo: 출시, 개시; 제품이나 계획, 활동을 새로 시작하는 일
reason: Removed the erroneous Korean wrestling-technique inversion and selected the ordinary launch sense.

meaningEn: a prize; something awarded in a lottery, raffle, or competition
meaningKo: 상품, 경품; 추첨이나 경기 등에서 주는 상
reason: A lot can be an object, not only a sum of money.

meaningEn: pay; money received for work
meaningKo: 급여; 일한 대가로 받는 돈
reason: Pay need not be monthly.

meaningEn: favourable; expressing support or being advantageous
meaningKo: 호의적인, 찬성하는, 유리한
reason: Removed the requirement of interpreting something in a biased way.

meaningEn: a writer; a person who creates written works
meaningKo: 작가, 저술가; 글로 된 작품을 쓰는 사람
reason: Removed painting from the imported writer definition.

meaningEn: the accused; a person charged with a criminal offence
meaningKo: 피고인; 형사 사건으로 기소된 사람
reason: Corrected the civil-defendant definition; accusé belongs to criminal accusation rather than ordinary civil litigation.

meaningEn: cream; the fat-rich part of milk used in cooking and dairy products
meaningKo: 크림; 우유에서 얻는 지방 함량이 높은 부분
reason: Cream is not pure white oil; clarified the dairy substance.

meaningEn: an extension; an increase in size or scope, or a part added to an existing structure
meaningKo: 확장, 증축; 규모를 늘리거나 기존 구조물에 덧붙인 부분
reason: Replaced generic continuation with enlargement or an added building part.

meaningEn: to kiss; a formal or literary use, especially for kissing a hand or forehead
meaningKo: 입을 맞추다; 특히 손이나 이마에 입을 맞추는 격식적이거나 문어적인 용법

meanings.ja: 口づけする（格式ばった、または文学的な用法）

reason: Kept the attested kissing sense with register context; this verb also has a common sexual sense. Fact checked against https://www.dictionnaire-academie.fr/article/A9B0148 ; no source examples copied.

meaningEn: a copy; a reproduction of a document or other original
meaningKo: 사본; 문서나 원본을 복제한 것
reason: Clarified the resulting copy rather than only the act of machine photocopying.

meaningEn: a diploma or qualification awarded for successfully completing a course of study
meaningKo: 졸업장, 학위나 자격; 학업 과정을 마친 것을 증명하는 것
reason: Removed the university-only restriction; diplôme can certify different levels of study.

meaningEn: innovation; the introduction of a new idea, method, or product
meaningKo: 혁신; 새로운 아이디어나 방법, 제품의 도입

meanings.ja: 革新、新しい方法などの導入

reason: Innovation need not entirely replace every existing practice or organisation.

meaningEn: a trade union; an organisation representing workers and their interests
meaningKo: 노동조합; 노동자와 그 이익을 대표하는 조직
reason: Selected the ordinary trade-union sense rather than any organisation of multiple people.

meaningEn: an avenue; a broad street, often lined with trees
meaningKo: 대로; 흔히 가로수가 늘어선 넓은 거리
reason: Narrowed the generic road or path definition to avenue.

meaningEn: champagne; sparkling wine produced in the Champagne region of France
meaningKo: 샴페인; 프랑스 샹파뉴 지역에서 생산한 발포성 포도주
reason: Removed the incorrect colourless restriction; champagne can also be rosé.

meaningEn: dynamic or energetic; active and enterprising
meaningKo: 활기찬, 역동적인; 적극적으로 활동하는
reason: Removed niceness as a required personality trait; selected energy and initiative.

meaningEn: a director; the person directing a film or audiovisual production
meaningKo: 감독; 영화나 영상물의 제작과 연출을 지휘하는 사람

meanings.ja: 映画監督、映像作品の監督

reason: Removed sports coaching and general concert management from the audiovisual director sense.

meaningEn: a maîtrise; a former French university qualification awarded after four years of higher education
meaningKo: 메트리즈; 프랑스에서 대학 4년 과정을 마친 뒤 받던 학위

meanings.de: die Maîtrise; früherer französischer Hochschulabschluss nach vier Studienjahren
meanings.es: la maîtrise; antiguo título universitario francés tras cuatro años de estudios
meanings.ja: メトリーズ；フランスの旧制4年間の大学課程修了資格
meanings.zh: 法国旧制四年大学学位

reason: Replaced an undifferentiated graduate degree or its holder with the historically bounded French qualification. Verified against https://www.larousse.fr/dictionnaires/francais/ma%C3%AEtrise/48746 .

meaningEn: wild; living or growing without domestication
meaningKo: 야생의; 길들여지지 않고 자연에서 사는
reason: Replaced the imported uncivilised-human framing with the ordinary wild-animal sense.

meaningEn: showy or conspicuous; strongly attracting attention through appearance
meaningKo: 눈에 띄는, 요란한; 외관이 강하게 시선을 끄는
reason: Removed disorder as a requirement; voyant describes visual conspicuousness.

meaningEn: a square; a shape with four equal sides and four right angles
meaningKo: 정사각형; 네 변의 길이가 같고 네 각이 직각인 도형
reason: Corrected square versus generic quadrilateral.

meaningEn: to specify or clarify; to give exact details
meaningKo: 명확히 하다, 자세히 밝히다

meanings.ja: 詳しく示す、明確にする

reason: The verb does not require written expression.

meaningEn: to carry out or perform an action
meaningKo: 수행하다, 실시하다
reason: Removed opposition or danger as a requirement of effectuer.

meaningEn: to identify; to establish what or who someone or something is
meaningKo: 식별하다, 확인하다; 무엇인지 누구인지 알아내다
reason: Replaced determining value or authenticity with identifying nature or identity.

meaningEn: to justify; to give a valid reason or evidence for something
meaningKo: 정당화하다, 이유를 설명하다
reason: Justifier does not imply the action was unjustifiable beforehand.

meaningEn: almost or nearly
meaningKo: 거의
reason: Replaced a Korean counterfactual fragment with the ordinary adverb meaning.

meaningEn: a motorway; a major road designed for fast motor traffic with controlled access
meaningKo: 고속도로; 자동차의 빠른 통행을 위해 진출입을 제한한 도로
reason: Narrowed the generic road between towns to a motorway.

meaningEn: a communiqué; an official written statement or announcement
meaningKo: 성명, 공식 발표문
reason: Distinguished the written statement from the act of publicly presenting an opinion.

meaningEn: the devil; an evil supernatural being in religious belief or stories
meaningKo: 악마; 종교나 이야기에서 악한 초자연적 존재
reason: Selected the ordinary supernatural-being sense, rather than a broad figurative immoral thing.

meaningEn: fusion; a combination of two or more different things into something new
meaningKo: 퓨전, 융합; 서로 다른 둘 이상의 것을 결합해 새로운 것을 만드는 것
reason: Corrected more than two to two or more; the example combines two cuisines.

meaningEn: a Jew; in this religious sense, a person who follows Judaism
meaningKo: 유대인; 이 종교적 의미에서는 유대교를 믿는 사람
reason: Replaced an overgeneralised historical and linguistic definition with the religious-person sense used by the lowercase noun in the example.

meaningEn: a scandal; an affair causing public indignation or disapproval
meaningKo: 스캔들, 추문; 대중의 분노나 비난을 일으키는 사건
reason: Scandale is not limited to rumours of a romantic affair.

meaningEn: tea; a drink made by infusing tea leaves in hot water
meaningKo: 차; 찻잎을 뜨거운 물에 우린 음료
reason: Distinguished ordinary thé from the broader category of herbal infusions.

meaningEn: an audience; the people listening to or watching a programme, performance, or message
meaningKo: 청중, 시청자; 방송이나 공연 등을 듣거나 보는 사람들
reason: An audience need not be physically gathered in one venue.

meaningEn: a faculty; a university division devoted to a field of study
meaningKo: 학부, 단과대학; 특정 분야를 담당하는 대학의 구성 단위
reason: Distinguished a university faculty from an entire university.

meaningEn: to modify or change something
meaningKo: 수정하다, 바꾸다
reason: Modification need not remove the original object and replace it entirely.

meaningEn: profit; income remaining after costs have been subtracted
meaningKo: 이익; 수입에서 비용을 뺀 뒤 남은 금액
reason: Distinguished profit from gross income or remuneration for work.

meaningEn: to inscribe or write something on a surface or in a record
meaningKo: 적다, 기입하다, 새기다
reason: Inscrire does not require cutting a hard object; the original definition describes engraving only.

meaningEn: a desert; a region with very little precipitation and sparse vegetation
meaningKo: 사막; 강수량이 매우 적고 식물이 드문 지역
reason: Removed sand cover as a requirement; deserts can be rocky or otherwise lack sand.

meaningEn: a bird; a feathered vertebrate with a beak and wings
meaningKo: 새; 깃털과 부리, 날개가 있는 척추동물
reason: Removed the claim that every bird can fly.

meaningEn: recruitment; the process of finding and selecting people for work or an activity
meaningKo: 모집, 채용; 일이나 활동에 참여할 사람을 구하고 뽑는 일
reason: Narrowed generic collection of people, goods or works to recruiting people.

meaningEn: a cell; a small room used to confine a prisoner
meaningKo: 감방; 수감자를 가두는 작은 방
reason: A cellule need not house only one prisoner; the example specifies that this prisoner is alone.

meaningEn: a chapel; a relatively small Christian place of worship
meaningKo: 예배당; 비교적 작은 기독교 예배 공간
reason: Narrowed a generic church-building definition to chapel.

meaningEn: a ray; a narrow line or beam of light
meaningKo: 광선, 빛줄기
reason: Removed fire and flowing-water energy from the light-ray sense.

meaningEn: a virtue; a morally good quality or habit
meaningKo: 덕, 덕목; 도덕적으로 좋은 성품이나 습관
reason: A virtue is not limited to generosity or accepting others.

meaningEn: to adopt; to legally take a child into a family as one’s own
meaningKo: 입양하다; 아이를 법적으로 자신의 자녀로 맞아들이다
reason: Removed the requirement that the child has been abandoned and the casual taking-in wording.

meaningEn: a nomination; official selection as a candidate for an award
meaningKo: 후보 지명; 상을 받을 후보로 공식 선정되는 것
reason: Clarified nomination for an award rather than general eligibility or possibility.

meaningEn: to confront or face a difficulty, danger, or opponent
meaningKo: 맞서다, 대면하다; 어려움이나 위험, 상대를 마주하다
reason: Replaced merely facing one another physically with confronting a challenge or opponent.

meaningEn: the suburbs; areas around a city outside its central districts
meaningKo: 교외; 도시 중심부 바깥의 주변 지역
reason: Removed quietness and relaxation as necessary properties of suburbs.

meaningEn: to train or coach someone through practice
meaningKo: 훈련시키다, 지도하다
reason: Corrected the English wording to causative training rather than learning oneself.

meaningEn: preservation; keeping something in good condition or preventing its loss
meaningKo: 보존; 좋은 상태를 유지하거나 사라지지 않게 함
reason: Removed political conservatism imported from a Korean homograph and selected preservation.

meaningEn: inspiration; a creative idea or influence that stimulates imagination
meaningKo: 영감; 창의적인 생각을 떠올리게 하는 자극이나 착상

meanings.ja: インスピレーション、着想

reason: Replaced strengthening motivation in general with creative inspiration.

meaningEn: a metropolis; a large city that is a major regional centre
meaningKo: 대도시; 지역의 중요한 중심지인 큰 도시
reason: A metropolis need not be a national capital.

meaningEn: a bay or opening in a wall, especially a large window opening
meaningKo: 벽의 개구부, 특히 큰 창문 공간
reason: Removed the communication-window restriction and selected architectural opening.

meaningEn: a cardboard box
meaningKo: 종이 상자, 골판지 상자
reason: Carton in this selected container sense is cardboard, not a wooden box.

meaningEn: to diminish or decrease in amount, size, or intensity
meaningKo: 줄다, 감소하다
reason: Removed restriction to force or power; diminishing intensity fits the tiredness example.

meaningEn: an incident; an unexpected event that interrupts or causes difficulty
meaningKo: 사건, 돌발 상황; 진행을 방해하거나 문제를 일으키는 뜻밖의 일

meanings.ja: トラブル、突発的な出来事

reason: Narrowed a generic event attracting attention to the ordinary disruptive incident sense.

meaningEn: to dismiss someone from a job; a euphemistic use
meaningKo: 해고하다, 내보내다; 완곡한 표현
reason: Added the necessary euphemistic register for the dismissal sense, verified in the Académie: https://www.dictionnaire-academie.fr/article/A9R1569 .

meaningEn: slim or slender; having a narrow or thin body
meaningKo: 날씬한, 호리호리한
reason: Removed height and attractiveness as requirements of the physical adjective.

meaningEn: a bear; a large mammal with a heavy body, thick fur, and strong limbs
meaningKo: 곰; 몸집이 크고 털이 두꺼우며 팔다리가 튼튼한 포유류
reason: Removed the restriction to brown or black fur, which excludes polar bears.

meaningEn: to provoke; to deliberately cause someone to react or become angry
meaningKo: 도발하다; 일부러 반응이나 분노를 일으키다
reason: Replaced generic doing something first with intentional provocation.

meaningEn: the sixth person or thing in a sequence or ranking
meaningKo: 여섯 번째 사람이나 것, 6위
reason: Corrected ordinal rather than cardinal total of six.

meaningEn: a line or stroke drawn on a surface
meaningKo: 선, 획; 표면에 그은 줄
reason: Removed a queue of people or objects, which does not match trait.

meaningEn: a stand or grandstand; a raised seating area for spectators
meaningKo: 관중석; 관객이 앉도록 높여 만든 좌석 공간
reason: Corrected seating structure versus the group of spectators themselves.

meaningEn: a flower bud before it opens
meaningKo: 꽃봉오리; 피기 전의 꽃
reason: Narrowed to the flower bud sense, distinct from a generic leaf or stem bud.

meaningEn: to exist; to be real or present
meaningKo: 존재하다, 있다
reason: Exister is not restricted to remaining after something could have disappeared.

meaningEn: a modification; a change or alteration
meaningKo: 수정, 변경
reason: A modification need not correct an error.

meaningEn: to repeat; to say or do something again
meaningKo: 반복하다, 다시 말하다
reason: Repeating can occur once and need not be continual.

meaningEn: to assert or state something firmly
meaningKo: 단언하다, 확언하다
reason: Removed the imported requirement that the assertion be unreasonable or an excuse.

meaningEn: a depression; an area of low atmospheric pressure
meaningKo: 저기압; 주위보다 기압이 낮은 영역
reason: Selected the meteorological French sense, replacing the Korean metaphor for a bad mood. This corrected row must not propagate through its former mood-sense concept.

meaningEn: a journey or route between two places
meaningKo: 이동 경로, 두 장소 사이를 가는 길
reason: A trajet need not be a route fixed beforehand for a particular purpose.

meaningEn: to press; to apply pressure to something, commonly with sur
meaningKo: 누르다; 보통 전치사 sur와 함께 씀
reason: Removed the requirement that pressure be vertically downward.

meaningEn: a manager; someone who organises and supervises a team or business activity
meaningKo: 관리자, 매니저; 팀이나 사업 활동을 조직하고 감독하는 사람
reason: A manager need not be the highest representative of an owner or control all sales.

meaningEn: a prescription; a medical document specifying medicines or treatment
meaningKo: 처방전; 약이나 치료 내용을 적은 의료 문서
reason: A prescription need not instruct someone to compound a medicine.

meaningEn: permanence; the quality of continuing or remaining stable over time
meaningKo: 지속성, 항구성
reason: Removed literal eternal duration as a necessary condition.

meaningEn: savings; money set aside rather than spent, or the act of saving it
meaningKo: 저축, 저축한 돈
reason: Selected the financial-saving sense rather than general conservation of resources.

meaningEn: an accusation; a claim that someone has done something wrong or illegal
meaningKo: 혐의 제기, 비난; 잘못이나 범죄를 저질렀다는 주장
reason: An accusation is not restricted to a victim filing a formal complaint with authorities.

meaningEn: conquest or attainment; gaining something through effort or struggle
meaningKo: 정복, 획득; 노력이나 투쟁으로 얻는 것
reason: Clarified gaining independence rather than generic overcoming of a difficult condition.

meaningEn: a descent; movement downwards
meaningKo: 하강, 내려감
reason: Removed deity or senior-person restrictions imported from the Korean source sense.

meaningEn: smoke; airborne particles and gases produced by burning
meaningKo: 연기; 물질이 타면서 생기는 입자와 기체
reason: Corrected smoke versus steam; the original Korean 김 entry was misaligned.

meaningEn: rental or hire; obtaining temporary use of something in return for payment
meaningKo: 임대, 대여; 돈을 내고 일정 기간 빌려 쓰는 것
reason: The noun denotes the rental arrangement or activity, not solely the money paid.

meaningEn: to care for or treat a sick or injured person or animal
meaningKo: 돌보다, 치료하다
reason: Narrowed the generic watching-over sense to the health-care sense used by the example.

meaningEn: to contact; to get in touch with a person or organisation
meaningKo: 연락하다; 사람이나 기관에 연락을 취하다
reason: Removed mental or physical touching, which was an unrelated Korean sense inversion.

meaningEn: a photographic flash; a device producing a brief burst of light for a photograph
meaningKo: 플래시; 사진 촬영을 위해 순간적으로 빛을 내는 장치
reason: A flash is not restricted to night photography.

meaningEn: legislation; the body of laws in a country or concerning a subject
meaningKo: 법령; 나라나 특정 분야에 적용되는 법의 체계
reason: Replaced the misleading English law-and-order expression with a body of laws.

meaningEn: a defendant brought before a French court for a délit or contravention
meaningKo: 프랑스에서 경죄나 위경죄로 법원에서 재판받는 피고인

meanings.de: der Angeklagte bei einem französischen Strafgericht für délits oder contraventions
meanings.es: el acusado ante un tribunal francés por un délit o una contravention
meanings.ja: フランスで軽罪や違警罪の審理を受ける被告人
meanings.zh: 在法国因轻罪或违警罪受审的被告

reason: Corrected uncharged suspect to a defendant appearing before the relevant French criminal court. Source: https://www.dictionnaire-academie.fr/article/A9P4265 .

meaningEn: rock; the natural solid material forming much of the ground
meaningKo: 암석; 땅을 이루는 단단한 자연 물질
reason: Removed the large-flat-stone restriction, which does not define roche.

meaningEn: a crossroads or junction; a place where roads meet
meaningKo: 교차로; 도로들이 만나는 곳
reason: A carrefour need not have exactly four branches.

meaningEn: hey; an informal call used to attract attention
meaningKo: 야, 어이; 주의를 끌기 위해 부르는 감탄사
reason: Removed Korean age-relationship constraints from the French interjection.

meaningEn: fully or completely
meaningKo: 충분히, 완전히
reason: Removed helplessness and extreme negative-outcome connotations from the source idiom.

meaningEn: to survive; to stay alive or continue to exist despite difficulty
meaningKo: 살아남다, 존속하다
reason: Surviving does not require rescue by another person or a specific near-death event.

meaningEn: a circus; a show or company featuring acrobats, clowns, and similar performers
meaningKo: 서커스; 곡예사나 광대 등이 공연하는 무대 또는 단체
reason: Included the circus company as well as its performance; animal acts are not necessary.

meaningEn: a companion; someone who accompanies or shares an activity with another person
meaningKo: 동행, 동료; 함께 있거나 활동하는 사람
reason: Clarified companion rather than only an intimate friend.

meaningEn: tender or soft; easy to cut, bite, or deform
meaningKo: 부드러운, 연한
reason: Removed silky slipperiness as a requirement; tendre describes softness or tenderness.

meaningEn: to display or post information so that it can be seen
meaningKo: 게시하다, 표시하다
reason: Removed the unrelated causing someone to suffer or experience sense from Korean 보이다.

meaningEn: a cemetery; an area containing graves
meaningKo: 묘지; 무덤들이 있는 구역
reason: Distinguished a cemetery from the location of a single grave.

meaningEn: the seventh person or thing in a sequence or ranking
meaningKo: 일곱 번째 사람이나 것, 7위
